set.body: Bounded new-current-main study authorized by owner on 2026-10-08. Exercise ArBiasCorrection.Ols through ordinary public first-level fitting in the existing first-level-laws court. Declare and hash design/noise/censor cells, independent seed domains, replicate budgets and acceptance criteria before any pilot or confirmation outcomes. Validate generator covariance/run boundaries and known-noise controls; compare paired raw and corrected GLS on AR coefficient recovery, residual whiteness, contrast standard errors/interval coverage, and null t/F rejection. Retain every result and refusal, use actual independent replicate counts, preserve adverse outcomes, distinguish regression-screen evidence from scientific confirmation, and run both JVM and Scala.js. Report measured runtime and source-bound receipts. This does not replace the historical broad calibration campaign or qualify group effective df, corrected iterative/robust fitting, ARMA estimation or a PHRF pilot.
set.title: Corrected GLS: known-truth scientific qualification on JVM and Scala.js
